prompt.es: Escribe tres normas para un parque comunitario con excepciones y una razón.

answer.text: Rule 1: Dogs must be kept on a lead, except in the fenced area, in order to protect children and animals. Rule 2: Music may be played on condition that it does not disturb other visitors, given that the park is a quiet place for many families. Rule 3: Bicycles are to be left at the racks, apart from delivery bikes, so as to keep the main path clear. Fishing may not be allowed in the pond unless the committee gives a permit, since fish and birds need a quiet place.
accepted: Rule 1: Dogs must be kept on a lead, except in the fenced area, in order to protect children and animals. Rule 2: Music may be played on condition that it does not disturb other visitors, given that the park is a quiet place for many families. Rule 3: Bicycles are to be left at the racks, apart from delivery bikes, so as to keep the main path clear. Fishing may not be allowed in the pond unless the committee gives a permit, since fish and birds need a quiet place.

First, rubbish must be taken home, except on festival days, because the bins are full by noon. Second, fires may only be lit in the marked area, given that dry grass burns easily. Third, dogs are to be kept on a lead, apart from guide dogs, in order to keep the playground safe for small children. Finally, the gates shall be locked at ten unless the committee has approved an event, since neighbours need quiet at night.

feedback.es: Una norma justa une una regla en pasiva, una excepción o condición razonable y una razón que la justifique (in order to, given that, since).
